page: Alibaba Cloud ecs.n2.large is a general-purpose virtual machine instance belonging to the ecs.n2 server family. It is built on the KVM hypervisor and features an x86_64 architecture. The instance is equipped with 4 dedicated vCPUs, derived from 2 physical Intel Xeon 8269CY processor cores running at 2.5 GHz with hyper-threading enabled. It includes 16.0 GB of system memory, providing a balanced 4.0 GB of RAM per core. This instance does not include local storage or bundled GPUs.

Performance benchmarks place this instance primarily in the lower tiers of compute and memory capabilities. The single-core and multi-core stress-ng CPU benchmarks register at 1089.08 and 4315.32 respectively, both falling into the bottom 25% of tested hardware. Similarly, Geekbench scores show a single-core result of 873.0 and a multi-core result of 2768.0. Memory bandwidth tests show a read-only small block speed of 313.13 GB/sec and a large block read speed of 32.61 GB/sec, though the large block write speed reaches an average tier at 28.16 GB/sec.

Given the performance profile, the ecs.n2.large is suited for low-intensity general-purpose workloads, basic web serving, and lightweight database operations. Passmark database operations scored 1111.04, and Redis SET operations achieved 5.02 million operations per second. The lack of local storage requires reliance on network-attached storage, and the absence of a GPU rules out accelerated computing tasks. It represents an entry-level dedicated resource option where high-throughput compute is not a primary requirement.
